instructions: ChatGPT Supervisor updates this file only while reviewing JANUS-generated capability requests. Each entry must record approve/disapprove/defer, reason, implementation state, and version. JANUS never writes or self-approves this file.

decisions.reason: Approved with a narrower security design than direct repository access. JANUS may submit bounded diagnostic records only through the authenticated server maintenance channel. The channel exposes no GitHub/source-repository credential, arbitrary repository/file read or write, process execution, package installation, configuration mutation, self-approval, or deployment primitive. Owner/ChatGPT Supervisor remains the authorization boundary for source changes.
